description_en: Verifies whether one or more alert event IDs belong to a specified server
description_zh: 验证一个或多个告警事件ID是否属于指定服务器
name: CheckSecurityEventId

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to be verified.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要验证的服务器UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the alert events to be verified. You can specify up to 100 alert event IDs. If this parameter is left empty, the verification result Data defaults to false, indicating that the events do not belong to the specified server.
Call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to retrieve this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要验证的告警事件ID。最多支持设置100个告警事件ID。该参数为空，验证结果Data默认为false（不属于）。
调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: security_event_ids

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event IDs belong to the specified server. Valid values:
true: The alert events belong to the specified server.
false: The alert events do not belong to the specified server
Data.description_zh:
告警事件ID是否属于指定服务器。取值：
true：属于
false：不属于

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
